hypothesis: Among equally bounded, already scored but unexpanded vertices, access to unseen low-indegree neighbors predicts missing-neighbor recovery better than query distance alone.
scope: Mechanistic falsification on exposed historical GloVe traces, not a shipping search implementation, novelty proof, held-out result, or latency claim.
shadowSelection: Closest 256 offered, unexpanded vertices by recorded distance then stored ID; includes rejected and evicted vertices. No oracle or answer IDs available to selection.
unseen_count: Greedily maximize number of neighbors not evaluated by the original search or selected in this extension; ties use distance then stored ID.
unseen_rarity: Greedily maximize sum of 1/(1+directed indegree) over those unseen neighbors; ties use distance then stored ID.
alternating_distance_rarity: Alternate distance and unseen_rarity, beginning with distance; no fit or learned parameters.
extension: Expand only the fixed shadow vertices; consume previously unseen neighbor IDs in original adjacency order, stopping at the vector or expansion cap. No recursive extension. Selection never receives the exact oracle. Scoring is modeled, not executed.
outcome: Oracle coverage of original final top-10 union newly encountered IDs is a candidate-recall ceiling. Report per-query gain, wins/ties/losses, worst coverage, below-90% count, all selected IDs, expansions, new-vector counts, adjacency reads and priority-neighbor visits. This does not establish final reranked recall.
cost: All methods share the same shadow, adjacency cache and expansion/vector caps. Report common cache reads and each policy's extra priority scans separately; equal vector caps do not imply equal compute. Full indegree table and graph are counted as required metadata. No speedup inferred from this probe.
promotion: A non-distance policy must recover at least 10% more misses than distance in BOTH 100K ef cells at BOTH budgets, with worst candidate coverage no lower in any of the eight size/ef/budget cells. Otherwise reject this proxy family for native implementation. Passing only licenses a native experiment against distance continuation, current two-hop serving search, and adaptive-beam prior art at measured equal quality and total work.
failureRule: Freeze source and protocol before running; preserve all cells, including losses. Do not tune policies, shadow size, budgets or thresholds after results. Abort on input hash mismatch, malformed trace, resource failure or correctness-test failure.
